narration.text: A ceramics shop's three card-processing statements checked against its contract and Visa's published rates, five overcharges credited, a markup raised back to the first of the month, a regulated debit billed as exempt, a closed merchant ID, a wrong rate and a fee the contract does not name, while downgrades billed at their own rate, pass-through assessments, the fees the contract names, a credit already paid and a statement past its window are left alone. This is a chore for the owner of a small online ceramics shop in Oregon, who takes Visa payments through a processor on an interchange-plus agreement and has never checked a statement. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 118 dollars of the 118 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 13 traps, and she walked past 13. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 67 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
